title: नेपाली भाषा शिक्षणका समस्या र समाधानका उपाय
nepali: भाषा मानवीय एवम् सामाजिक वस्तु हो । भाषाका माध्यमबाट परस्परमा विचार वा भावनाहरूको साटासाट गरिन्छ । यसलाई सामाजिक सञ्चारको प्रणालीका रूपमा समेत चर्चा गरिएको पाइन्छ । भाषा शिक्षण सम्बन्धित भाषाको सिप विकाससम्बद्ध कार्य हो । भाषा शिक्षणले कुनै पनि व्यक्तिलाई सम्बन्धित भाषामा कुशल एवम् प्रखर बनाउँदछ । भाषा शिक्षणका क्रममा विभिन्न किसिमका समस्याहरू देखा पर्न सक्दछन् । त्यस्ता समस्याहरू विद्याथी, शिक्षक, समाज आदिसँग प्रत्यक्ष वा परोक्ष रूपमा जोडिएका हुन्छन् । जसबाट अपेक्षित सिकाइ शिक्षणमा नकरात्मक प्रभाव पर्दछ । भाषा शिक्षणलाई उद्देश्यमूलक, व्यावहारिक तथा प्रभावकारी बनाउनका लागि सबैखाले समस्याको समाधान आवश्यक हुन्छ । यसका लागि शिक्षक, विद्यार्थी, समाजका साथै सम्बन्घित सबै पक्ष सचेत एवम् क्रियाशील बन्नु पर्दछ । प्रस्तुत लेखमा भाषा शिक्षणका क्षेत्रमा देखापरेका समस्या र तिनको समाधानका उपायको बारेमा चर्चा गरिएको छ । यस लेखले भाषाशिक्षणलाई विषयका रूपमा अध्यापन गराइरहेका शिक्षक, अध्ययनरत विद्यार्थी तथा यस क्षेत्रमा रुचि राख्ने जोकोहीका लागि आवश्यकीय ज्ञान ग्रहण गर्न सहयोग पु¥याउने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ ।
american_english: Language is a human and social entity. Through language, ideas or feelings are exchanged with one another. It is also discussed as a system of social communication. Language teaching is a skill-oriented activity related to the development of the language. Language teaching makes any person proficient and active in the relevant language. During language teaching, various kinds of problems may be observed. Such problems are directly or indirectly connected with students, teachers, society, and so on. Because of this, negative effects fall on the expected learning outcomes. In order to make language teaching objective-oriented, practical, and effective, it is necessary for everyone to solve the problems. For this, teachers, students, society, and all the concerned parties must be aware and active. In the present article, the problems that have appeared in the field of language teaching and the ways to solve them are discussed. This article is expected to help teachers who teach language as a subject, students who are studying it, and anyone interested in this field to acquire necessary knowledge.

informal_english: Language is basically how we humans connect with each other and share stuff — ideas, feelings, all of it. Folks also talk about it as the system we use for social communication. Teaching a language is all about building up people's skills in it, you know, getting them good at it. A decent language teacher makes anyone proficient and chatty in that tongue. And let's be honest, teaching a language isn't always smooth going — all kinds of problems can pop up along the way. These issues are tied up with the kids, the teachers, the whole community, directly or indirectly, and that can drag down what the students are meant to be learning. So sorting out these problems is a must if we want language teaching to actually hit its goals, be useful in the real world, and get results. Teachers, students, society, and everyone involved have got to wake up to what's going on and get stuck in. This article digs into the problems showing up in language teaching and how to fix them. It's meant to give teachers who are handling the subject, the students currently studying it, and anyone with a interest in the area a solid handle on what they need to know.
